checks.name: Strict schema, fields, session/request identity, path/ADS/UNC/traversal/depth validation
Actual Hana-backed directory list projects only relative ordinary entries; credential names hidden
Actual UTF-8 preview equals disk bytes without cloud sanitation or model calls
Actual nested Markdown list/preview carries version and source
File change rejects old expected version
Changed workspace lease rejects old preview authority
Missing file has explicit not_found, no raw absolute path
Root escape and secret-file read are denied by main path guard
Hardlink and junction are not listed or previewed
Oversize text rejected before content allocation
Invalid UTF-8/NUL is unsupported without partial body disclosure
Only signature-verified local raster images are previewed
Unknown binary metadata is honest and contains no body (Office now covered by actual native UI)
Directory count is bounded and reports partial, not a complete listing
Cancelled and timed out reads return terminal structured errors
No-workspace failure never falls back to private session files
Real IPC functions reject wrong sender/extra fields before read
Matching scoped cancellation/duplicate ID is enforced in real IPC handler
All operations preserve original outside bytes
Authority change during read discards already-read result
Real IPC concurrency limit rejects ninth request and cancelled work returns no data
Actual IPC timeout returns at deadline while blocked native work still holds its bounded slot

boundaries: Actual bounded filesystem/Hana readonly service and real IPC handler functions with sender seam
